item.title: BBC World: Trump tells BBC that King's visit could 'absolutely' help repair relations with UK
item.description: In a phone interview with the BBC's North America editor, the president discussed next week's visit and his relationship with the UK PM.

item.title: ABC Business: Trump administration vows crackdown on Chinese companies 'exploiting' AI models
item.description: The Trump administration is vowing to crack down on foreign tech companies’ exploitation of U.S. artificial intelligence models, singling out China at a time that country is narrowing the gap with the U.S. in the AI race

item.title: ABC Business: Trump's 'gold card' visa starting at $1 million granted to just 1 person so far, White House says
item.description: President Donald Trump's “gold card” visa program, which allows foreigners to live and work in the U.S. for at least $1 million, has approved just one person since December, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick announced this Thursday

item.title: BBC World: US soldier charged after winning $400,000 betting on removal of Maduro
item.description: Gannon Ken Van Dyke allegedly made trades on Polymarket on the basis of classified information, the justice department says.

item.title: BBC Front Page: Southport dads: 'Running for our girls has made us like brothers'
item.description: Sergio Aguiar and David Stancombe run the London Marathon together in memory of Alice and Elsie.

item.title: BBC Front Page: Assisted dying bill to run out of time as Lords hold final debate

item.title: BBC World: More than 500 people killed in Tanzania election violence, inquiry finds

item.title: ABC Business: Union Pacific profit climbed 5% as it builds the case for its acquisition of rival Norfolk Southern
